events.name: The Moonless Camp

remembers.notice: The pale shape steps out of the trees. Cresselia, heard, not spoken: "It is not your enemy. It never was."

events.intro:
Camp, at night. Everyone falls asleep at once, you last. The moon is gone from the sky.

You wake inside a dream of the camp. Your Pokémon are asleep, twitching. One whimpers.

A figure at the edge of the firelight, made of smoke and a white plume: "They dream of losing you. I did not put it there. I only let them see it. Tell me your nightmare, and I will take theirs."

Behind it, something pale flickers in the trees and is gone.

success.text: Which one?
You hold the watch all night. Darkrai stays at the edge of the light until dawn, then speaks once: "You are stubborn. Good."
Darkrai: "Someone who would rather I did not exist."

events.name: The Moonless Camp: Your Nightmare
events.intro: Darkrai waits. The fire does not crackle.

success.text: You tell it about the first day, and the one you chose, and the dream where you lose them. Darkrai takes it, the way smoke takes a candle. Your team wakes rested.
You tell it about the last battle going wrong, and walking home alone. Darkrai takes it, the way smoke takes a candle. Your team wakes rested.
You tell it about coming back one day and nobody knowing your name. Darkrai takes it, the way smoke takes a candle. Your team wakes rested.

events.name: Darkrai: The Promise
events.intro:
Darkrai: "Where I sleep, they dream badly. Stop less. Let them breathe."

The Promise: Keep away from them: use at most every second rest node.

success.text: Darkrai walks a little behind you, always at the edge of the light. Your team sleeps well that night.

effects.text: Darkrai came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Darkrai leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Darkrai will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Fourth Statue

remembers.notice: One of the three statues turns its stone head. Keldeo: "They're watching."

events.intro:
Behind a waterfall, a cave with three tall swordsman statues: a Cobalion, a Terrakion and a Virizion, cut in stone. A fourth plinth is empty. Hoofprints lead to it and away.

A small blue Pokémon with a stubby horn backs out of the shadows, holding its ground.
Keldeo: "They said I'm not ready. They left me here to think. I've thought. I'm ready. I just need someone to see it. Battle me. Don't go easy."

success.text: Keldeo: "You haven't even seen me." It is hurt, and asks again.
A one-on-one, under the statues.
Keldeo: "I ran to help someone. Alone. I almost lost." Then it lowers its horn.

events.name: Keldeo: The Promise
events.intro:
Keldeo, win or lose: "You didn't go easy. Thank you." It climbs onto the empty plinth and stands there a moment, then jumps down.

Keldeo: "If I have to stand alone, so do you."

The Promise: Fight your own battles: accept no assist from a rival or ally.

success.text: Keldeo trots beside you out of the cave, head high.

effects.text: Keldeo came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Keldeo leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Keldeo will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: Command?
events.intro:
An abandoned lab on a cliff. Rust. A cracked pod, still warm. A screen flickers: COMMAND?

Behind the pod, a purple insect-machine with a cannon on its back, curled up. The screen scrolls: SUBJECT REVIVED 300,000,000 YEARS POST. MODIFIED. 4 DRIVES FITTED. AWAITING COMMAND.

It opens one red eye and looks at the screen, not at you.

success.text: It powers off. It stays here, curled up, quiet.
It wakes as a weapon.
You walk out. It follows you out of the lab, at a distance, and at the gate the screen it carries flickers.
Three minutes pass. It types back, slowly.

events.name: Command?: HOME?
events.intro: The screen: HOME?

success.text: It curls up by the pod again. It stays in the lab.
It types: SAME. It follows.
It follows. Sometimes it stops on a cliff and looks at the sea.

events.name: Genesect: The Promise
events.intro:
The screen: THEY CHANGED ME. NO ONE ASKED. DO NOT CHANGE THEM.

The Promise: No more machines: use no TM or technical item this run.

success.text: Genesect folds its cannon down and walks beside you.

effects.text: Genesect came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Genesect leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Genesect does not forgive. Break it once and it is gone.

events.name: One Pure Note

remembers.notice: Your Carbink bow to the stone. The voice inside goes very quiet, and very embarrassed.

events.intro:
A cave wall full of grey stone. One pink glint pulses with your heartbeat.

A tiny voice, from inside the stone: "Oh! Someone. Hello. I'm stuck. I made a diamond too big and it closed around me. One pure note would crack it. Not a loud one. A true one."

success.text: Which note?
It cracks wrong. Diancie tumbles out, free but chipped, and backs away from you.
Your Pokémon sings one note, and the crystal splits like a seed. Diancie steps out, blinking.

events.name: One Pure Note: The Note
events.intro: You take a breath.

success.text: Diancie giggles. "Try again."
Diancie giggles. "Try again."

choices.label: The one you hum when you are nervous.

success.text: The crystal rings, and splits, and she is free.

events.name: Diancie: The Promise
events.intro:
Diancie: "I'm supposed to be a princess. I'm not very good at it. Can I make you something? No. That's a trade. I want to give you something."

Diancie: "Things given are worth more than things sold."

The Promise: Sell nothing: sell no item this run.

success.text: Diancie walks with you, pink light in her hands, very pleased with herself.

effects.text: Diancie came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Diancie leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Diancie will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Steam Valley
events.intro:
Steam drifts across the route toward you and stops, suspicious. Every rock is wet and hot.

Out of the steam, a red-and-brown Pokémon with a great ring on its back. It stands between you and a small cave full of hurt Pokémon.

Volcanion: "Humans. What do you want? The last ones wanted my water. And then they wanted these."

success.text: Volcanion: "Then go." The steam closes over the path.
Volcanion: "Prove it." Two of the hurt ones need Berries; one needs carrying to a Center and back. It takes all stage, and Volcanion watches every step.
A poacher camp, one node away. Volcanion: "Go and look. Then come back and tell me what you'll do."

events.name: The Steam Valley: Again
events.intro:
The steam again, further on. It waits for you this time.

Out of the steam, a red-and-brown Pokémon with a great ring on its back. It stands between you and a small cave full of hurt Pokémon.

Volcanion: "Humans. What do you want? The last ones wanted my water. And then they wanted these."

success.text: Volcanion: "Prove it." Two of the hurt ones need Berries; one needs carrying to a Center and back. It takes all stage, and Volcanion watches every step.
A poacher camp, one node away. Volcanion: "Go and look. Then come back and tell me what you'll do."

events.name: The Steam Valley: The Camp
events.intro: The poachers' camp. Cages, stacked. Hurt Pokémon in most of them.

success.text: The poachers do not let them go quietly. Volcanion arrives on the last of them.
The Ranger comes, a stage later. Volcanion watches from the steam. It respects it. It does not trust it.
Volcanion destroys the camp with a single blast of steam and fire. Then it turns to you. "Are you afraid of me?"

events.name: Volcanion: The Promise
events.intro:
Volcanion: "Don't start helping something and walk away halfway. That's worse than not starting."

The Promise: Finish what you started: take in or find a home for every rescued Pokémon.

success.text: Volcanion walks with you, a long way off, steam rising from its ring.

effects.text: Volcanion came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Volcanion leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Volcanion does not forgive. Break it once and it is gone.

events.name: The Heart in the Box
events.intro:
A castle hall full of clocks, all stopped. On a pedestal, a heart-shaped box, ticking. Three tiny doors, one gear.

A note in the dust, in a careful hand: SHE WAS MADE 500 YEARS AGO. SHE WAKES FOR SOMEONE WHO KNOWS WHAT SHE IS FOR.

success.text: A tiny wind-up toy marches out and falls over. The box laughs: a ticking giggle.
The gear turns. Every clock in the hall starts at once. Magearna unfolds from the box.
A tiny wind-up bird whistles at you. The box giggles, ticking.

choices.label: Read the rest of the note.

success.text: SHE IS FOR GIVING. SHE WAS A GIFT.

events.name: Magearna: The Promise
events.intro:
Magearna curtseys. It holds out a bouquet of metal flowers.
Magearna, in chimes: "Carry this. To someone. You will know who."

The Promise: Carry this for me: one Pokémon holds her bouquet until the last stage.

success.text: One of your Pokémon takes the bouquet, carefully. Magearna chimes, and follows.

effects.text: Magearna came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Magearna leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Magearna will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: Lightning on the Ground
events.intro: Lightning crosses the ground, not the sky. It zigzags between the trees, stops a few steps from you, and is gone.

success.text: Scorched grass, in a line, going on ahead of you.

events.name: Lightning on the Ground: Again
events.intro: The lightning again, closer. It circles your party once, crackling, and leaves.

success.text: Your hair stands up. Something is checking you.

events.name: Lightning on the Ground: Zeraora
events.intro:
Lightning stops at your feet. A lean yellow-and-black cat stands where it stopped, crackling.

Zeraora: "Some time ago. A wild one, cornered. You took its side against a trainer. Why?"

It does not blink. It is checking.

success.text: Zeraora: "Most say that and don't mean it." It tests you: a battle, no items.
Zeraora: "That's honest." It sits.

choices.label: "I didn't. You've got the wrong person."

success.text: Zeraora looks at you a long time. Then it is lightning again, and gone.

events.name: Zeraora: The Promise
events.intro:
Zeraora: "I was caged once. The team you have is the team. Make it enough."

The Promise: No more cages: catch nothing more this run.

success.text: Zeraora runs ahead of you, and back, and ahead, like weather.

effects.text: Zeraora came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Zeraora leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Zeraora does not forgive. Break it once and it is gone.

events.name: The Hinge-Eater
events.intro:
The campfire. A clink. A tiny bolt-shaped Pokémon with a nut for a head is gnawing the hinge of your bag. It stops. It looks at you. It keeps gnawing. A second one pokes out of the firewood.

A tinkerer, from the next tent: "Oh no. Once there's two, there's always more."

success.text: You hold out something metal. It eats it, glows, and sits on your boot.
It goes. So does the bag hinge. Something falls out of the bag and is lost in the dark.
Tinkerer: "They eat metal. Give them one thing and they'll love you. Give them eight things and... well. You'll see."

events.name: The Hinge-Eater: Back
events.intro: Meltan is back, with three friends, and something of yours it is very proud of having found.

success.text: It gives back what it found, and eats something else instead, glowing.
Four Meltan go off into the dark, offended.

events.name: Meltan: The Promise
events.intro:
Meltan sits on your boot and looks at your bag, meaningfully.

The Promise: Feed me: give it one held item per stage.

success.text: Meltan rides on your bag, nibbling the buckle.

effects.text: Meltan came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Meltan leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Meltan will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: More
events.intro:
Eight Meltan stack on top of each other in the camp, wobble, and become one huge metal Pokémon with arms like hammers.

Melmetal, in a clanking voice: "More." It holds out a hand. Your bag rattles.

The tinkerer: "It wants to make things. Not eat them. Give it something good and see what happens."

success.text: It hammers what you give it into something better, and hands it back, still warm. The next reward you find is finer for it.

effects.text: Eight Meltan became Melmetal at your campfire, and it forged you something.

success.text: Melmetal: "...Hm." It sits. It waits for you to change your mind. By morning it is eight Meltan again, asleep in a pile.
Melmetal: "Things to give away. Made things go out. Not in." Then it comes apart into eight Meltan, satisfied, and they follow you.

events.name: The Fruit Test
events.intro:
Vines swing overhead. A pack of dark apes drops fruit on the path and watches from the branches. One fruit lands at your feet.

A Zarude, scarred, with a pink scarf, sits on a branch, arms folded. A small human child is tied in a hammock of vines behind it, asleep and safe.

Zarude, in growls: "The pack wants to see what you do with what's given."

success.text: The pack hoots. They think you are greedy, but quick. Zarude says nothing.
The pack throws fruit at you for a full minute. Zarude laughs.
You split it with your Pokémon. The pack goes quiet. Zarude climbs down.

events.name: The Fruit Test: The Child
events.intro:
A wanderer's child it found and raises. It is not stolen; nobody has come looking.

Zarude: "The pack says I should leave it. I won't. Would you?"

success.text: Zarude nods.
A sign in a town, a year old: LOST, AGE 2. That night Zarude carries the child to the edge of town and watches from a tree until the door opens.
Zarude: "Then go."

events.name: Zarude: The Promise
events.intro:
Zarude: "The small one. Whatever happens, the small one doesn't fall."

The Promise: It is yours now: the youngest Pokémon in your party must never faint.

success.text: Zarude swings along the branches above you, and the pack follows a while.

effects.text: Zarude came to you, and you made it a promise.

success.text: Zarude leaves a small gift (₽500) and goes. No harm done.
Zarude will forgive you once. The second time, it leaves.

events.name: The Darkest Dream

remembers.notice: Cresselia stands between you and the shadow. "Do it" is not something you can say tonight.

events.intro:
Night. Darkrai walks beside you, and its shadow does not match it.

Darkrai, heard, not spoken: "There is a shape I could take. In it, the dreams I bring would not end. Not for anyone. You have kept faith with me. I ask you, not myself."

success.text: Darkrai thanks you. Its shadow is its own again. In the last battle of this run, it means to stand beside you.

effects.text: Darkrai asked you whether to become something worse, and you said no.

success.text: The shadow rises. For one battle, Z-Mega Darkrai fights at your side. After it, the whole region sleeps badly.
Darkrai: "Because I would say yes."
